A1.justification: Both PDFs describe ImCoref-CeS and provide readable main text, equations, figures, tables and appendices. The relocated related work and renumbered appendices can be matched reliably.

before.justification: v1 reports original ImCoref and ImCoref-CeS experiments on OntoNotes, LitBank and WikiCoref, including ablations and sensitivity analyses in Section 4 and Appendix F.

after.justification: v2 retains these original benchmark results, ablations and sensitivity analyses in Section 4 and Appendix E.

M1.justification: The LBM variants, biaffine mention scorer, hybrid mention regularization, LLM Checker-Splitter and filtering procedures are unchanged. The appendix prompt templates also match.

E1.justification: Both versions use OntoNotes and LitBank and evaluate OntoNotes-trained models on WikiCoref. The long-text processing scenarios and other evaluated task conditions are retained.

E2.justification: Corresponding comparisons in Tables 2–4 and 15–17 retain the same baseline membership, including Maverickmes and the LitBank LLMLink comparison. Ablation comparator sets also remain unchanged.

E3.justification: Dataset splits, metrics, model configurations, training settings and testing procedures match. The detailed settings in v1 Appendix E are retained in v2 Appendix D, including validation-based model selection and early stopping.

E4.justification: Both retain the LBM, span-length and Checker-Splitter component ablations, eta/rho sensitivity studies, and associated Tables 18–20 and Figures 3, 4 and 6. The qualitative error analysis moves from Appendix G to Appendix F without substantive changes.

E5.justification: Both versions retain point-estimate reporting without reporting seed counts, confidence intervals or significance tests. No repeated-run or uncertainty-reporting information is added or revised.

E6.justification: Benchmark scores, ablation results, plotted trends and qualitative outputs match. For example, the GPT-4 variant retains Avg.F1 of 86.0% on OntoNotes and 73.2% on WikiCoref, while the DeepSeek variant retains 81.8% on LitBank in Tables 2–4.

T1.justification: The mathematical notation, Equations 1–8 and hybrid mention regularization span-length constraint are unchanged. No assumptions, derivations, theorems or proofs are added or revised.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction and conclusion retain the same contributions and performance claims for ImCoref and LLM-based refinement. The collaborative-mechanism novelty claim is retained within the relocated related-work section.

C2.justification: The accuracy–latency interpretation, mention-clustering limitations and proposed future cluster fusion remain unchanged. The error analysis retains the qualification that splitting can introduce erroneous coreference chains.

D1.justification: Annotation instructions, prompt examples, pronoun filtering, hyperparameters, optimizer, GPU hardware and training details are retained. Appendix renumbering adds no implementation or reproducibility information.

R1.justification: v1 Appendix A becomes v2 Section 5 with limited explanatory trimming. The cited works, comparisons with prior research and substantive novelty positioning remain unchanged.

P1.justification: Related work moves from Appendix A to Section 5 and is slightly shortened. The conclusion and appendices are renumbered, cross-references and the appendix overview are adjusted, and funding acknowledgments are added.

P2.justification: Figures 1–6 and Tables 1–20 retain their designs and content. Limited page reflow and caption cross-reference updates accompany the section relocation, and v2 removes printed page numbers.

improvement.justification: v2 mainly relocates and lightly shortens related work and adds funding acknowledgments. The scientific argument, empirical evidence, reproducibility details and limitations remain unchanged; the modest organizational and layout edits leave overall paper quality essentially unchanged.
